description: This is a light blue-green wooden bookshelf with a decorative scalloped base. It features three shelves filled with books, boxes, and some loose papers. The top shelf has several books arranged vertically and horizontally, along with a dark gray box. The second shelf contains stacks of books and wooden boxes. The third shelf has larger wooden and gray boxes, and a few more books. The bottom section of the bookshelf has an open drawer with two round knobs, revealing a glimpse of the interior.
